name: Cloudflare
description: Trigger Recursive automations from Cloudflare Notifications — deploy alerts, health checks, security events, and usage alerts arrive as webhook deliveries and an agent picks them up. Requires a Pro or Teams license.

events.label: Any notification
events.description: Fires on every Cloudflare notification delivered to this webhook, regardless of alert type. Narrow with filters (alert_type, account_id, policy_id, zone, project).

events.label: Deployment alert (Pages / Workers)
events.description: Pages and Workers build/deployment notifications (alert types prefixed pages_* / workers_*).

events.label: Health check status change
events.description: Health check status notifications (alert types prefixed health_check*).

events.label: Security event (DoS / WAF / firewall)
events.description: Security notifications — DoS/DDoS attacks, firewall anomalies, WAF and security insights alerts.

schema.label: Webhook Secret
schema.description: Shared secret set on the Cloudflare webhook destination (Notifications → Destinations → Webhooks). Cloudflare sends it in the cf-webhook-auth header on every delivery; verify() checks it with a constant-time compare.

onboarding.subtitle: Connect Cloudflare Notifications so agents pick up deploy alerts, health checks, and security events.

steps.title: Open Cloudflare Notifications
steps.desc: In the Cloudflare dashboard, go to Notifications → Destinations to create a Webhook destination pointed at your Recursive instance.

steps.title: Set a Webhook Secret
steps.desc: Choose a strong random string, save it here, then use the same value as the Secret when creating the Cloudflare webhook destination. Cloudflare sends it on every delivery in the cf-webhook-auth header.

steps.title: Verify setup
steps.desc: Confirm the required credentials are in place. Saving the destination in Cloudflare sends a test delivery that verifies the connection end-to-end.
